notes.title: Lords of Exile - Release Date Announced!
notes.notes:
[h2]📢 Hello Fellow Retro-Gamers! 📢 [/h2]

[h3]Thank you all for your patience and understanding. We are ready to announce the good news that everyone must be waiting for![/h3]

[h3]Lords of Exile, the nostalgia-inducing side-scrolling action platformer, is set to finally release on *drumroll please*[h2][b]14th February 2024[/b]![/h2][/h3]

[previewyoutube=jCLStFXS80E;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Stay tuned and get ready to embark on a journey filled with samurais, revenge, and pixelated excitement.[/h2]
